notes.title: Game Update 0921
notes.content: Optimized the save system — you can now store up to 3 save files.

notes.title: Demo V0.55 Updata Note
notes.content:
Difficulty Adjustment
Added a new "Hard" difficulty level. The new difficulty tiers are: Easy, Standard, Hard, and Chieftain.

"Hard" is easier than the previous "Chieftain", while the new "Chieftain" is more challenging than before.
Improved Building Pushing Interaction
Slightly increased the pushing distance between buildings.

Added sand and dust effects when pushing.
Content and Balance Changes
Double Cannon: Attack speed from 1 → 0.85

Scatter: Cooldown from 18 → 24

Mortar: Damage from 32 → 36

Allied Towers: Required towers from 15 → 10

Spearman: Frenzy after 5 attacks → Frenzy after staying on the battlefield for a while

1-6 Unlock: Expansion Prep → Crystal Research

2-A Unlock: Snowball Spell → Icebreaker

2-A Unlock: Crystal Research → Glass Cannon
Challenge Mode Rule Changes
Stages 1-6 and 2-4 now require mandatory blueprint and rune selections.

Stage 2-2 challenge now increases Orc HP by 50%.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where Allied Towers sometimes didn’t activate.

Fixed text overflow in the English "Thank You" popup.

Fixed the Flamethrower still making sounds when sound effects are disabled.
